customManagers.description: Track the secureblue base image tag in recipe.yml
Flag every hardcoded Terra release so they get bumped alongside image-version. Appears in files/dnf/terra.repo (baseurl and gpgkey) and in the recipe's repos.keys URL.

packageRules.description: image-version and the hardcoded Terra release must move together, so land them in one PR rather than two that each break the build on their own.
